title: Shoe Rotation Rest Days by Pair
dataSources: Closet activity (`style:wardrobe`), cleaning tasks (`style:cleaning`), shoe wears (`style:shoes`), beauty inventory (`beauty:product`), audits (`style:audit`).
app: Wardrobe and beauty telemetry — Stylebook closet exports, dry-cleaning reminders, shoe-rotation logs, and makeup inventory audits — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=style:shoes pair_name=* last_wear_epoch=* wear_epoch=*
| eval lag_days=round((wear_epoch-last_wear_epoch)/86400,1)
| stats avg(lag_days) as avg_lag_days, max(lag_days) as worst_lag_days by pair_name
| sort - avg_lag_days
description: Measures rest days by shoe pair for shoe rotation.
value: Lag tracking shows which shoe pair create the slowest handoffs, syncs, or review loops inside shoe rotation.
implementation: Capture the timestamps needed to compute `rest days` on `style:shoes` events and aggregate them by `pair_name`.
visualization: Table of shoe pair with average and worst rest days.
grandmaExplanation: It records how long things take for each shoe pair so you can see where shoe rotation slows down.
